Ybouane LiquidGlass, @ybouane/liquidglass 1.0.3
Source: https://github.com/ybouane/liquidglass
Author: Youssef Bouane (@ybouane).
Upstream README and package.json declare MIT licensing. The npm package does not include a standalone LICENSE file. Original bundle, README and package metadata retained unchanged. Demo images, videos, and fonts were not copied.
Integration uses a live Canvas2D copy of our own Three.js framebuffer as the backdrop.
